ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using IEInstal - File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using IEInstal.exe (UACMe 64)

sequences.query: (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\IEInstal\.exe" AND file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("consent\\\.exe$"))
